issues.summary: Nightly build job fills /var/builds on ci-runner-2
issues.description:
ci-runner-2 ran out of disk twice last week. Every nightly build leaves a folder under /var/builds and nothing removes them.

We cleared it by hand for now. Longer term the cleanup script should run on a schedule.

comments.author: marcus.webb@northwind.dev
comments.body: Cleared 212 GB by hand. Closing; the scheduled cleanup is its own ticket.

issues.summary: Move CI artifacts to the shared S3 bucket
issues.description: Artifacts live on each runner's disk, so a rebuilt runner loses them. Upload them to `s3://northwind-ci-artifacts` after each build and keep 30 days.

issues.summary: Structured logging for the deploy scripts
issues.description: The deploy scripts print free text, so the log search can't filter by service or step. Emit one JSON line per step with the service, the step, and the outcome.

issues.summary: retry() retries 4xx responses that can never succeed
issues.description:
`retry()` in lib/retry.js retries on every error, including 400 and 404 from the partner API. Those will fail the same way every time, so we burn eight attempts and about four minutes before giving up.

It should give up at once on a 4xx other than 429.

issues.summary: Upgrade Node to 22 in the CI image
issues.description: Node 18 is out of support. Bump the CI image to Node 22 and fix whatever breaks.
The release steps live in Marcus's head. Put them in docs/releasing.md.

issues.summary: Search page shows stale results for a few minutes after a deploy
issues.description: After a deploy the search page serves results from the old index until the cache expires.
The staging credentials were in a screenshot posted to #eng. Rotate them.
